paragraphs.text: Kavu (/kɑːvu/ KAH-voo ; pl. Kavu ) is a mainly creature type used for cards that depict carnivorous mutant reptiles with long, low heads, square jaws and four or six legs.
Sapient Kavu-folk called Kav can be found in the Edge , a region of space at the very limits of the Multiverse .
Kavu mainly appear in red and green . Although, Firescreamer and Vicious Kavu are black -aligned, and Radiant Kavu is white -aligned.
Kavu were known as 'dingo lizards' during Invasion set development.

Kavu were introduced in the Invasion block . The Time Spiral block printed one new Kavu in each set: Firemaw Kavu ( Time Spiral ), Kavu Predator ( Planar Chaos ), and Kavu Primarch ( Future Sight ). Dominarian Kavu would return in Dominaria , Modern Horizons 2 , Dominaria United and March of the Machine .

Edge of Eternities introduced the humaniod Kav, the first Kavu outside of Dominaria. Kav culture takes inspiration from African and Asian cultures. Their cuisine borrows heavily from Ethiopian cuisine , including doro wat , tibs , and injera . Subedar and Jemadar are South Asian military ranks. Laager is an Afrikans word for a wagon fort common in South Africa, while kfar is Hebrew for "village".

Kavu have always been thought to be native to Dominaria . Dominarian Kavu are fifteen feet tall, with heavy back limbs and sharp, quick forelimbs. They have thick, hoofed fingers that allow them to be equally nimble on land or in trees. Kavu come in all sizes and shapes, quickly adapting themselves to their environment. Their size ranges from that of a large dog to that of two elephants .
Kavu translates either to "ever watchful" or to "carved from stone."

From what is known, they are an ancient species that at some point hibernated beneath Dominaria's surface. During the Phyrexian Invasion , Multani 's magic revived them, and they immediately went about fighting the war. Shiv and Yavimaya seemed to have the greatest concentration of powerful Kavu dormant beneath them. Gaea may have had a hand in their creation or their awakening, a belief which is common among the Llanowar elves.

When the Kavu emerged from their ancient nests, food chains long dormant became vibrant again. It was said that it took Yavimaya a thousand years to breed them, but that it took only seconds for them to prove their worth. To the Kavu, all Phyrexians were merely crunchy snacks. Dominarians gladly fought alongside them until the Kavu figured out some Dominarians were quite tasty, too.

After the invasion, the Kavu have become a regular presence on Dominaria for quite some time. Enough so, to have become entrenched in the local culture. In Llanowar , especially in the Kelfae elfhame , the Kavu have become integrated in the elvish lifestyle, now bred as a means of travel, warfare, labor and occasional food. Elven knights ride Kavu in battle. Hallar in particular is considered to have a particularly strong bond with their Kavu steed, Serahane .

In a work of convergent evolution, sapient Kavu-folk called Kav ( 40 cards ) can be found in the Edge , a region of space beyond the limits of the Multiverse . They are native to the planet Kavaron , and organized in the Kavaronic Federal Empire . Endangered by their dying world, Kav are considered a protected species in Pinnacle space.

Most of the Kav who survived now inhabit massive mining stations positioned above and around the shattered remains of Kavaron . The majority of these Kav work as miners, moxite hunters, or serve on memorial crews that form the core of the Kav Memorial Navy (KMN). Whether operating as miners or sailors, Kav are known for their practical skills in combat, favoring physical and martial approaches to challenges, and displaying fierce dedication to their duties. Additionally, some Kav offer their expertise as mercenaries to mining teams from other species, providing both guidance and protection to outside crews navigating the dangerous ruins of their ancestral homeworld.
Most Kav speak Imperial Kfar, although many know Psimer. Cormale is a third gender that is visually similar to females, which can use he/him or she/her pronouns.

Because the Kav evolved on their bellies, they describe the world by touch rather than sight; a Kav may say that something "feels good" rather than "looks good." Kav footsteps always fall into sync, maintaining a constant rhythm. Their reaction time is also much faster than humans': Kav reaction time to visual stimulus can be less than 20 milliseconds, compared to 150 milliseconds to touch in humans. Rather than short- and long-term memories, Kav have stable attention stacks. They refer to this shifting present as the Long Now. Because they evolved to be tossed around by larger beasts, Kav relax when surprised or stressed. Their heads are crowned with horn-hairs or hair-horns, they shed their scales, and their blood is green. They have a gizzard, which uses silt to process food, and a poisontaster sinus, through which they can sift air to test its toxicity. Their brains are regenerative like human livers, capable of processing physical trauma. Their blood clots quickly, making Kav prone to strokes.

The Alchemy: Edge of Eternities card Mine Security has a more animalistic Kavu on a chain leash. This suggests that Kavaron is home to feral Kavu along with the sapient Kav, and that some have been domesticated.
Kavu Monarch is a Kavu Lord .
